name: opcua-mcp-server
description: Read industrial sensors and control equipment on any OPC UA server.
long_description:
Connects Claude to any OPC UA server — a PLC, a SCADA gateway, a historian or a simulator — and exposes it as MCP tools: read and write nodes, browse the address space, call methods, and read history and server-side aggregates.

Set the endpoint below to your OPC UA server's URL, for example `opc.tcp://192.168.0.10:4840`.

**Security:** this release connects with no encryption and no authentication, and it can write nodes and call methods on whatever it is pointed at. Use it against a simulator or a lab server, not against production equipment, and scope the OPC UA account it connects with to exactly what you intend Claude to be able to do.

opcua_server_url.title: OPC UA endpoint
opcua_server_url.description: URL of the OPC UA server to connect to, e.g. opc.tcp://192.168.0.10:4840
